name: Ixalan

bio.text: Long before, the Coin Empire invaded the Core, turned on the Oltec and caged Chimil, who destroyed her prison after 320 years of darkness.

bio.text: Jace arrived with no memory and was found by Vraska, and the Sun Empire, River Heralds, Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition and Huatli, Angrath and Vraska all raced for Orazca and the Immortal Sun.

bio.text: Vraska summoned Tezzeret, who took the Immortal Sun off the plane, and Tishana declared Ixalan at peace.

bio.text: In the New Phyrexian Invasion Phyrexian hosts overran the continent until the Sun Empire, pirates and the Legion of Dusk united and Zacama felled Etali.

citations.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Ixalan (plane)", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The invasion exposed the Core's entrances, and Vito freed Aclazotz, whom the Oltec, Kellan and Amalia helped defeat.

bio.text: Afterwards Caztaca, Elenda and Beckett Brass formed an alliance, and Saheeli, who had lost her spark, lives there.

timeline.summary: Vraska becomes employed by Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: Vraska becomes employed by Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Seriously wounded, Jace flees to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Seriously wounded, Jace flees to Ixalan

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace is found by Vraska and joins the crew of the Belligerent.
timeline.quote: Jace is found by Vraska and joins the crew of the Belligerent .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace defeats Azor and becomes romantically involved with Vraska.
timeline.quote: Jace defeats Azor and becomes romantically involved with Vraska .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds the Immortal Sun for Bolas and Tezzeret takes it away.
timeline.quote: After Vraska had found the artifact, she summoned Tezzeret, who took it away with his Planar Bridge.

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas", section "Claiming the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace becomes trapped on Ixalan by the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Jace became trapped on Ixalan by the power of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Amonkhet". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz kills the Ancient One and usurps his place among the Deep Gods.
timeline.quote: He was killed by Aclazotz, who usurped his place in the pantheon.

citation.text: "List of deities", section "The Deep Gods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Months later Vraska captains The Belligerent, and the compass directs her crew south.
timeline.quote: Set course due south,

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
timeline.quote: It was Jace Beleren.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska sees Jace is emaciated and ill, drops her petrifying gaze and asks what happened to him.
timeline.quote: Vraska snuffed the fire in her mind and looked down at him with no magic in her eyes.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: A Legion of Dusk ship appears and Vraska recalls an earlier attack and the vampires' pursuit of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Immortal Sun was stolen from their monasteries

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders an attack; Jace camouflages the ship and she silences it with an assassin's spell as they approach.
timeline.quote: The Belligerent was now imperceptible to any outside its rails.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew boards the vampire ship and takes it by surprise.
timeline.quote: The vampires were caught completely off guard.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska fights the vampire captain with Jace's illusion clones and petrifies him when he grabs Jace.
timeline.quote: The vampire's skin and clothes turned to stone in her grip.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace is amazed rather than afraid at Vraska's gorgon power and thanks her, calling her talented.
timeline.quote: Jace was not afraid. He was amazed.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana catches up with Kumena on the coast, where he conjures storms against approaching ships, and she overpowers his spell.
timeline.quote: I subsume his spell with magic of mine own.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana rams a ship into a sea stack and exchanges barbs with Kumena before he punches her and knocks her out.
timeline.quote: I look over my shoulder just in time to see Kumena's fist hit my face.

citation.text: "The Shapers" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Adrian Adanto claims land in the name of the queen.
timeline.quote: "I claim this land in the name of the queen."

citation.text: Legion's Landing (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Arguel's vision leads him into the jungles of Ixalan to the lost temple of Aclazotz.
timeline.quote: Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .

citation.text: Arguel's Blood Fast (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Captain Vance carves the cliffs with a broadside to form her new home, the Spitfire Bastion.
timeline.quote: With a broadside assault, Captain Vance carved the cliffs to form her new home.

citation.text: Vance's Blasting Cannons (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Pirates venture into the interior for treasure and find something far greater.
timeline.quote: The pirates had ventured into the interior for treasure. They found something far greater.

citation.text: Lost Vale (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Angrath calls dinosaurs dragons, and the name sticks in certain pirate circles.
timeline.quote: When the Planeswalker Angrath called dinosaurs "dragons," the name stuck in certain pirate circles.

citation.text: Dragonskull Summit (Ixalan Promos, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jace awakes on Ixalan certain that he is lost.
timeline.quote: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.

citation.text: Ixalan's Binding (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Adrian Adanto claims land for the queen.
timeline.quote: I claim this land in the name of the queen.

citation.text: Legion's Landing (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk builds up its fort walls just in time for pirates to burn them down.
timeline.quote: Wary of the ferocious dinosaurs, the Legion of Dusk built up the walls of their fort—just in time for the pirates to burn them down.

citation.text: Fiery Cannonade (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker Angrath, trapped on Ixalan, captures ships but cannot break free.
timeline.quote: Trapped on Ixalan, the Planeswalker Angrath is the only minotaur sailing the seas.

citation.text: Hijack (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Legion's conquistadors surround a dinosaur only to find it has outflanked them.
timeline.quote: The conquistadors surrounded the dinosaur only to find that it had outflanked them.

citation.text: Spike-Tailed Ceratops (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Captain Brinely Rage sees nature rise against them.
timeline.quote: It appears that nature has risen against us.

citation.text: Thundering Spineback (Ixalan, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Trapped by Ixalan's Binding, Angrath joins Captain Radcliff's crew, then leads a nearly bloodless mutiny and renames the ship Devil's Chains.
timeline.quote: the minotaur led a quick and almost bloodless mutiny that left Radcliff hanging by a gaff hook strapped to the bowsprit.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath recognizes Huatli as a planeswalker and offers help leaving the plane; she attacks him, but they later join in the race for Orazca.
timeline.quote: He recognized Huatli as a fellow planeswalker and offered her assistance in leaving the plane in exchange for help, but at first, she attacked him and fled.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath tries to planeswalk to Kaldheim, deduces the blocker is near, and tells Huatli true freedom starts when one realizes one is trapped.
timeline.quote: He told Huatli that true freedom started when one realized that one was trapped.

citation.text: "Angrath", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor travels to Ixalan and sacrifices his spark to create the Immortal Sun, trapping himself there too.
timeline.quote: By this act, he also trapped himself on the plane.

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor fights alongside Elenda of Garrano defending Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Azor fought alongside Elenda of Garrano in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Azor", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thorn seizes the wheel of the Dire from former captain Gram Greddis and raids the nearest vessel, forcing its captain to walk the plank.
timeline.quote: Brandis himself boarded the ship and ordered its captain to walk the plank

citation.text: "Brandis Thorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Daphne Vail, lookout of the Ugly Mug, stays silent as the Dire Fleet approaches, then asks Thorn for a promotion and becomes first mate of the Dire.
timeline.quote: Impressed, he made her first mate of the Dire , securing her loyalty forever.

citation.text: "Brandis Thorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thorn takes the Salty Dog and finds the stowaway Oscar Flinch halfway down the plank.
timeline.quote: he found someone already halfway down the plank: a stowaway named Oscar Flinch.

citation.text: "Brandis Thorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Flinch tells of his old vessel being taken by a snake-haired woman seeking the golden city; intrigued, Thorn takes him aboard the Dire.
timeline.quote: Captain Thorn took Flinch back with him to the Dire

citation.text: "Brandis Thorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thorn leads an expedition into the heart of Ixalan using Flinch's knowledge of the golden city.
timeline.quote: Captain Thorn is using Flinch's piecemeal knowledge of the location of the golden city to lead an expedition into the heart of Ixalan.

citation.text: "Brandis Thorn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Brass begins issuing cosmium prospecting deeds enforced by the Bluecoats to legitimize the Coalition as a state.
timeline.quote: Enforcing these deeds are the Bluecoats

citation.text: "Brazen Coalition", section "After the invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Saheeli Rai teaches Sun Empire engineers to build dozens of mechanical dinosaurs for the invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: Saheeli Rai taught Sun Empire engineers to produce dozens of mechanical dinosaurs

citation.text: "Dinosaur", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Komon and Oltec humans flee the caverns for the surface, while those who remain seal off the Core.
timeline.quote: The Komon and Oltec in the caverns fled, finding safety outside of the caverns.

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli rises to a station just short of nobility through her skill at sword, magic and controlling dinosaurs.
timeline.quote: Huatli rose to a station just short of nobility

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Early Career". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli fights vampire incursions on the Sun Coast and is honored by the Emperor.
timeline.quote: Huatli fought against the vampire incursions on the Sun Coast

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Ignited yet unawakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Angrath tells Huatli he seeks the Immortal Sun and in their battle her spark ignites.
timeline.quote: In their battle, her spark ignited

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Ignited yet unawakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli is proclaimed warrior-poet and tasked to reclaim the Golden City.
timeline.quote: Huatli was proclaimed warrior-poet of the Empire and tasked by the Emperor to reclaim the Golden City for the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Ignited yet unawakened". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli teams with Tishana to keep Kumena from the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Huatli temporarily joined up with the merfolk Tishana

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Angrath leaves her, Huatli sends a dinosaur to trample him in the mud.
timeline.quote: Huatli reacted by sending a Dinosaur to trample him in the mud.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Now able to planeswalk, Huatli returns home riding Zacama, and the emperor lets her use the title Warrior-Poet.
timeline.quote: Huatli first returned home, using the Elder Dinosaur Zacama as a mount

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli planeswalks away from Ixalan.
timeline.quote: she planeswalked away.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his spark, trapping himself and preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Azor created the Immortal Sun by imbuing it with his planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion of Dusk, Brazen Coalition, Kumena, Huatli, Angrath and Vraska race to Orazca for the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: In the race for Orazca, the planeswalker Angrath joined the fray, as well.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Race". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska poses as a pirate on the high seas while Jace is stranded on Ixalan without his memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska poses as a pirate on the high seas, while Jace Beleren is stranded on the plane with the loss of all his memories.

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire and River Heralds are met by the Legion of Dusk and the Brazen Coalition as all race for Orazca's secret.
timeline.quote: The dinosaur -riding warriors of the Sun Empire and the merfolk shamans of the rival River Heralds are met by the vampire conquistadores of the Legion of Dusk and the pirates of the Brazen Coalition .

citation.text: "Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hundreds of thousands of Komon Winaq migrate to the surface, later becoming the Sun Empire, while those who stay become the Oltec.
timeline.quote: Those who stayed behind began to call themselves Oltec .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "First Exodus". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A fungal outbreak at Topizielo spawns the mycoids, which overrun the caverns; the Oltec seal the Core's entrances.
timeline.quote: Those who remained in the caverns sealed all entrances to the Core to protect it from the spread of the mycoids.

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Birth of the Mycotyrant". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Azor creates the Immortal Sun in 3279 AR to trap Nicol Bolas, preventing planeswalkers from leaving Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the planeswalker Azor created a powerful artifact known as the Immortal Sun to trap Nicol Bolas .

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Apatzec Intli I uses the Immortal Sun without restraint in a devastating war with the River Heralds.
timeline.quote: who had gained possession of the Immortal Sun and used it without restraint

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire retakes Orazca and pushes the Legion of Dusk back, then launches the Dawn Fleet toward Torrezon.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire pushed the Legion of Dusk back to the sea

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Quiet Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace arrives on Ixalan with no memory.
timeline.quote: When he arrived he had no memory of who or what he was.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska's crew fishes Jace out of the sea.
timeline.quote: After several days, he was fished up by Vraska and her crew.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace's memories partly return after he falls into the Golden City's waters.
timeline.quote: To Vraska's horror, the shock caused Jace's memories to partially return.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska asks Jace to remove her memories of him.
timeline.quote: Vraska asked Jace to temporarily remove her memories of him.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska hires Malcolm to serve aboard the Belligerent in search of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Malcolm was hired by Captain Vraska to serve aboard the pirate ship Belligerent in search of the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sirens of Ixalan are described as mercurial creatures who serve on Brazen Coalition crews, in at least one case as captain.
timeline.quote: They are mercurial creatures who can turn in an instant from loving to murderous

citation.text: "Siren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Ixalan, a ship's carpenter adds a cosmium gem to a siren figurehead, animating it into an artificial flying siren.
timeline.quote: a ship's carpenter added a cosmium gem to their siren figurehead, which animated it into an artificial flying siren

citation.text: "Siren", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I reduces the empire to a few coastal cities and costs it Orazca.
timeline.quote: Following a devastating war with the River Heralds under Apatzec Intli I

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Early history". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The empire, besieged by Brazen Coalition raids and the Legion of Dusk, rises to fight off its enemies.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire was besieged by pirate raids by the Brazen Coalition and the advance of the Legion of Dusk

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Facing the New Phyrexian Invasion, the Sun Empire joins forces with the Legion of Dusk.
timeline.quote: the Sun Empire was forced to join forces with the Legion of Dusk to defend the plane.

citation.text: "Sun Empire", section "Revival". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Legion's first expedition to Ixalan ends in disaster with the second loss of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: The Legion of Dusk's first expedition to Ixalan would end in disaster: a humiliation at Orazca, the second loss of the Immortal Sun, and Elenda's chastising of the Legion upon her return to Alta Torrezon.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "First expedition to Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Treasure tokens are introduced in the Ixalan block, replacing the problematic Gold token idea with an added tap.
timeline.quote: so R&D had to add a tap and change the token's name.

citation.text: "Treasure", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vona sails on the first ship to Ixalan and cuts a swath across it, seeking Elenda.
timeline.quote: Vona was on the first ship that left port

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vona's agents fail to find the Temple of Aclazotz; Alante claims the chalice.
timeline.quote: her agents failed to locate the temple

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vona steals the Thaumatic Compass from Vraska; Huatli and Tishana retrieve it.
timeline.quote: she managed to steal the Thaumatic Compass from Vraska

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda reappears, tells followers they are free, and says she will become the sun's sentinel; Mavren Fein punishes Vona and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the Legion left the continent of Ixalan

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska poses as a member of the Brazen Coalition and assembles her crew.
timeline.quote: Vraska posed as a member of the Brazen Coalition

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska finds the shipwrecked, memoryless Jace and spares him.
timeline.quote: Seeing that he had no memory of who he was, she spared him

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace's memories return and he forgives Vraska for her past transgressions.
timeline.quote: Jace instead forgave Vraska for her past transgressions against him

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace uses the Living Guildpact to banish the sphinx Azor to Useless Island.
timeline.quote: Vraska witnessed how Jace used his power as the Living Guildpact to banish the Sphinx to Useless Island

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska has Jace remove her memories of him so Bolas cannot read them.
timeline.quote: Vraska asked Jace to remove all her memories of him

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who removes the Immortal Sun from Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Vraska summoned Tezzeret

citation.text: "Vraska", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A storm and a Legion of Dusk ship converge as the ship nears Ixalan, and Vraska orders abandon ship.
timeline.quote: Jace saw the Legion of Dusk ship coasting atop the water.

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: A wave sweeps Jace and Vraska off the deck and The Belligerent rams into the rocks.
timeline.quote: And The Belligerent rammed into the rocks.

citation.text: "Something Else Entirely" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona's ship closes on the Belligerent, hoping to board and feed on its crew.
timeline.quote: Boarding the pirate ship was ironic, but necessary to keep her sated.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: A conjured storm tosses Vona's ship, which rams into a sea stack and wrecks on the shore.
timeline.quote: just as her ship rammed into the side of the sea stack

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona kills and drinks from an injured pirate, declaring him guilty of deceit.
timeline.quote: I find you guilty of deceit, and a criminal in the eyes of the Church.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vona marches into the jungle alone, intent on taking the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: She was the Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun was hers for the taking.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace and Vraska, who leapt overboard in the storm, swim ashore.
timeline.quote: he had leapt overboard alongside Vraska.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace puts a charging vampire to sleep with his mind magic.
timeline.quote: The vampire in front of him stumbled in the sand and collapsed to the ground, snoring.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies another vampire with her gaze, warning Jace to close his eyes.
timeline.quote: A petrified vampire lay at his feet.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
timeline.quote: We lost Edgar

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Breeches volunteers the crew to fight the Legion of Dusk while Vraska and Jace seek the Sun, to be tracked by Jace's illusion.
timeline.quote: We fight Dusk, you find Sun! Meet up later!

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska orders the crew to leave the locals alone but kill every vampire.
timeline.quote: kill every vampire you find.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace veils himself and Vraska in invisibility and hides their footprints as they flee upriver in the dinghy.
timeline.quote: He shut his eyes and dutifully willed a veil of invisibility over himself and Vraska.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska reveals to Jace that neither is from Ixalan and that she is a planeswalker, planeswalking in front of him.
timeline.quote: We're Planeswalkers.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska theorizes that Orazca holds the enchantment that stops them from leaving the plane.
timeline.quote: I believe that Orazca doesn't just contain the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace works out that the compass points to blooms of powerful magic and aetheric north, which is why it pointed to him.
timeline.quote: We thought the compass was just pointing to the city, but it points to blooms of powerful magic.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska apologizes for hiding her planeswalking and thanks Jace for listening to her story.
timeline.quote: No one has ever listened to my story like you did. Thank you.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace senses people nearby, including a minotaur.
timeline.quote: One human, one vampire, a merfolk . . . and a minotaur.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli and her riders search the beach for a River Herald who could guide her to the Golden City.
timeline.quote: This is where she would find her guide to lead her to the Golden City.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli glimpses Vraska among the wrecked ships.
timeline.quote: Her skin was emerald green, more reptilian than anything else

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the unconscious Tishana on a rock and wakes her.
timeline.quote: There, lying on the rock overlooking the vast, unending ocean, was an unconscious female merfolk.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana tells Huatli that a River Herald, Kumena, has betrayed her cause and is heading to Orazca.
timeline.quote: A River Herald has betrayed my cause and is traveling there now.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli kneels and swears she means no claim on Orazca, and Tishana agrees to guide her, warning she will kill her if she tries to claim it.
timeline.quote: We are not each other's enemy.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana senses that Huatli really did see the city and gives her the terms of the alliance.
timeline.quote: If you say you saw a city when you skimmed the edges of our world, then I believe you.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana animates a jade totem into an elemental mount.
timeline.quote: began to form the shape of an elemental

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli sends Inti and Teyeuh after a fleeing vampire.
timeline.quote: Inti, tail them!

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana spots an illusion on the river water, which she judges beyond the vampires' mastery.
timeline.quote: Someone is casting an illusion there, on the water.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli resolve to take the compass from the illusionist's boat, and Tishana admits even the River Heralds do not know where Orazca is.
timeline.quote: We need their compass more than we need them dead

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska steers the boat toward the bank as the river narrows, and the two planeswalkers camp in the boat for the night.
timeline.quote: We'll sleep in the boat,

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace conjures a glowing illusory draft horse as a beacon for Malcolm and the crew.
timeline.quote: A large draft horse materialized above them, glowing a delicate blue against the night sky, and ran upward into the canopy.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska sings a Golgari song and talks with Jace before he falls asleep.
timeline.quote: The Golgari have little to be cheery about.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska decides she can trust Jace, possibly wants more than friendship, and resolves to petrify whoever stole his memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska knew in that moment that, memory or no, this was a man she could trust

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska resolves to petrify whoever stole Jace's memories.
timeline.quote: Vraska couldn't wait to petrify whoever had stolen his memories.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: They abandon the boat and hack through the jungle, finding a dinosaur-made path.
timeline.quote: Vraska and Jace abandoned their boat the next morning.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: A vampire conquistador ambushes them under a cloud of dark smoke.
timeline.quote: A thick cloud of dark smoke suddenly flooded the grove around them.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace dispels the darkness spell and Vraska fights the exposed vampire while Jace conjures an illusory storm.
timeline.quote: The dark smoke dissipated, leaving a conquistador standing exposed.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: The vampire knocks Jace down and steals the thaumatic compass, fleeing into the jungle.
timeline.quote: snagging the thaumatic compass from the ground at Jace's feet

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace goes to track the vampire but hears the minds of Tishana and Huatli pursuing it.
timeline.quote: What he heard instead was a pair of furious internal monologues.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana's illusory flying snake crashes into Jace's psychic defense.
timeline.quote: An immense, illusory, flying snake crashed into his arms and split on either side of Jace's psychic defense.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana snares Jace with vines, breaking his illusion.
timeline.quote: vines whipped up from the forest floor to wrap themselves around Jace's legs.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana and Huatli introduce themselves and Tishana demands the compass or their deaths.
timeline.quote: Hand over the compass or die where you stand.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Jace tells them the vampire took the compass, and Tishana and Huatli leave to hunt it.
timeline.quote: The vampire took the compass from us.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli and her dinosaur hunt the vampire for nine hours.
timeline.quote: It took nine hours.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli's dinosaur seizes and shakes the vampire until the compass falls out, then Huatli lets it go and leaves the vampire to a raptor.
timeline.quote: An odd-looking compass flung out of her pocket and hit the ground.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana examines the compass, which lights and shows Orazca is half a day away.
timeline.quote: The end of our peregrination is near.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana betrays Huatli as the Belligerent crew ambushes them and Amelia binds Huatli in canvas.
timeline.quote: the slap of a large flap of canvas covering her face and knocking her off her mount

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska petrifies Huatli's clawfoot and retakes the compass.
timeline.quote: Her clawfoot was in front of her, crouching for an attack, jaws wide open . . . and entirely encased in stone.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska explains how the crew caught up, using Malcolm in the sky and Jace's telepathy.
timeline.quote: It's much easier to find shortcuts with an eye in the sky and a telepath on the ground.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Huatli summons clawfoots that scatter the pirates, and Tishana conjures a flood against the fleeing crew.
timeline.quote: she summoned a flood to careen through the jungle

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Tishana abandons Huatli to stop Kumena alone, breaking their bond.
timeline.quote: I must stop Kumena on my own.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath appears and chases Huatli, entangling her with a chain.
timeline.quote: a chain whacked and wrapped around her ankle, yanking Huatli to the forest floor.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath says he will not harm Huatli, and proposes they escape together by finding the city.
timeline.quote: Whatever prevents us from leaving this plane is locked in that city.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Angrath adds that they must kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca.
timeline.quote: And all we have to do is kill everyone who tries to steal Orazca from our grasp.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: The compass vibrates and Malcolm sees the city ahead as the crew runs through the fog and mountains.
timeline.quote: It's on the hills ahead!

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: The crew sees the spires of Orazca.
timeline.quote: Shining as golden beacons above the green, the spires of Orazca pierced the sky.

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska and Jace discuss what the Immortal Sun might do, joking about Lord Nicolas.
timeline.quote: Maybe Lord Nicolas is a rock collector?

citation.text: "The Race, Part 2" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Kumena nears Orazca using little magic to avoid Tishana.
timeline.quote: He was nearing the golden city of Orazca, the resting place of the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Vraska is hit by an image of a broken white brick barrier at a harbor on a plane she has never visited.
timeline.quote: There was a massive barrier made of white brick against a turbulent sky.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath watch Orazca rise from the valley.
timeline.quote: They watched as the golden spires of Orazca climbed higher and higher above the canopy of the valley below.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli finds the real city unlike the one in her vision.
timeline.quote: The city was more beautiful than she could possibly have imagined . . . and it looked nothing like the city she had seen in her vision.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli tells Angrath her emperor sent her to find Orazca.
timeline.quote: My emperor tasked me with this.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
timeline.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath leads Huatli into the Blind Eternities-like space between planes by planeswalking.
timeline.quote: Her perception wavered, and she leaned forward into a separate realm.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli looks through Angrath's portal at a snowy mountain plane and is yanked back by the barrier.
timeline.quote: Huatli tore through space and color and back through the fabric of existence

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath names the plane they saw as Kaldheim and explains freedom starts with knowing you are trapped.
timeline.quote: Kaldheim,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath says they must be near whatever keeps them locked on the plane.
timeline.quote: We must be near whatever is keeping us locked on this plane,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath reveals he wants to see his daughters, whom he has not seen in fourteen years.
timeline.quote: I want to see my daughters

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli and Angrath find a bat-marked tomb near Orazca and Huatli recalls the legend of the Bat of the East.
timeline.quote: There's a legend that says the bat of the East met Aclazotz

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: A pale hand slides the tomb door aside and Saint Elenda emerges.
timeline.quote: a pale white hand reached out from the interior.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath identifies the vampire as Saint Elenda.
timeline.quote: You are Saint Elenda,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda says Orazca has awoken at last.
timeline.quote: Orazca has awoken at last.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli threatens Elenda, refusing to let the Legion of Dusk take the city.
timeline.quote: I refuse to allow the Legion of Dusk to take the city.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda says she came only to retrieve what was hers and leave the rest in peace.
timeline.quote: To retrieve the one thing that is ours,

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda laments that the Church turned her ritual into invasion.
timeline.quote: I left the Church with the knowledge of the ritual to take on my burden

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot and vanishes through a dark slice in the air.
timeline.quote: She stepped forward, past Huatli and Angrath, and vanished into a dark slice in the air.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Angrath attacks Huatli with a chain, then runs ahead to Orazca.
timeline.quote: Angrath launched a chain at Huatli's face that she just barely dodged, its heat searing her cheek.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli resolves to beat Angrath to Orazca.
timeline.quote: was going to get there before she did.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

citation.work: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun
citation.text: "Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Elenda meets Angrath and Huatli and is appalled that the Legion of Dusk became cruel invaders.
timeline.quote: was appalled to hear that the Legion of Dusk had become cruel invaders in her absence

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Sanctum of the Sun she refuses Mavren Fein's request to retrieve the vanished Immortal Sun, tells the vampires they are free, and rebukes Vona.
timeline.quote: Elenda refused, telling the vampire that they were finally free from their ancient duty

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Elenda fights alongside Azor in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Elenda fought alongside Azor in defense of Ixalan during the New Phyrexian Invasion .

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vraska summons Tezzeret, who spirits the Immortal Sun off the plane, revealing Bolas's plan to invade Ravnica.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to spirit the Immortal Sun off the plane.

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Theft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Orazca is found, but claiming it requires a fight; the winner will wield the greatest power of the plane.
timeline.quote: The legendary city of Orazca has been found, but it is not claimed without a fight.

citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An unexpected rival takes the prize of Orazca for his master.
timeline.quote: An unexpected rival takes the prize for his master

citation.text: "Rivals of Ixalan", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Huatli's summoned dinosaur bowls Angrath over and pins him.
timeline.quote: then effortlessly bowled him over and trapped him underfoot.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Tishana arrives with her clan and confirms her agreement with Huatli stands.
timeline.quote: I assembled my clan. Our agreement stands.

citation.work: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake
citation.text: "The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Jan 2018.

timeline.summary: Huatli leaves Angrath under the dinosaur and goes with Tishana.
timeline.quote: Angrath, I'm sorry, but I need to go with Tishana. We had a deal first.
